entities.summary: James Percivell Hardy was an American professional basketball player. Hardy played the forward position in the National Basketball Association (NBA) from 1978 to 1982. He played collegiately at the University of San Francisco. At 6 ft 9 in (206 cm) and 220 pounds (100 kg), he played as a power forward.
